draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.26, the 66th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 11th of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 113, well after his grade rank (66th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Mike Hilton. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (17th percentile), vertical jump (8th percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2022, 22nd of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears. 28 career games and 7 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026.
